title: Funnels For Herbalism
intro: Funnels are simple yet essential tools used in herbalism and home apothecary practices. They are typically made of glass or plastic and are used to transfer liquids or powders from one container to another without spilling. In herbalism, funnels are crucial for accurately measuring and transferring tinctures, decoctions, and herbal extracts during preparation. Their use ensures precision and hygiene, making them a valuable addition to any herbalist's toolkit.
